Vera: Quick note  I'm consolidating a small 'what-to-check' list for customers migrating from v1 to v2. Opening PR with short snippets and an examples folder. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/710

Omar: Can we add an explicit mapping example for response fields + a tiny curl -> v2 SDK pair? People keep tripping on choices -> output mapping.

Vera: Yep. Drafted this mapping: `v1: choices[0].text` -> `v2: output[0].content`. Will include python and curl examples.

Priya: Add a one-liner about KV cache cold starts when swapping model families: "Warm with a few short requests to populate KV cache, expect higher latency for the first 5-10 requests."

Omar: Also add a short section on streaming differences and an example handling `response.completed` so folks can access final metadata. Example: ```
with client.responses.stream(model="redwood-stream", input="sum") as s:
  for ev in s:
    if ev.type=="delta": print(ev.delta, end="")
    if ev.type=="response.completed": print(ev.metadata)
```

docs-bot: link-checker: no broken links in PR #710 preview. snippet-linter: minor style nit on triple-backtick fences.

Vera: I'll fix the fence style and add a short deprecation timeline at the top: announce 2026-04-15, warnings in SDKs 2026-05-15, final retire 2026-07-01.

Priya: Please also reference the automated migrator script `tools/migrate-v1-to-v2.sh` in the examples folder so customers can try a sandboxed transform.

Omar: I'll add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: tokenization changes, sampling parity, quantization differences, and a pointer to run `ri-eval compare` to sanity-check outputs.

Vera: Great. Landing after the fence nitfix and small FAQ. Tagging @Priya for final review.
